import os
from cyhole import SolanaFM

api_key = os.getenv("SOLANA_FM_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("SOLANA_FM_API_KEY environment variable not set")

# Initialize SolanaFM client
client = SolanaFM(api_key=api_key)

# Request CSV export of account transfers (replace with actual account address)
account_address = "YOUR_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS"
csv_data = client.exports.account_transfers(account_address, format="csv")

# Save to report file
report_path = "account_transfers_report.csv"
